4319.beginText: Toads hopped to you and told you the dinner was ready. Ask them what the dishes of the dinner are.
4319.finishText: Worms! Fresh worms for dinner! Hehe, just kidding... or not.

4320.beginText: While you didn't know how to reject their invitation, the toad who reported for you returned. You can pay a visit to Taeko Sensei.
4320.finishText: So you are the human who wants to learn the Eight Gates.

4321.beginText: You felt relieved as you didn't have to eat worms to study Eight Gates. Ask him how to study Eight Gates.

4322.beginText: Continue to comply with Taeko Sensei.
